sample_rule: Each math task selects the same 64 items by fixed ID hash; PolyMath stratifies 16 per difficulty. Up to 6000 output characters; fewer than 50 alphabetic characters not measured.
limitations: Automatic language ID on formula-rich text is not human-verified output-language correctness. English technical/math fragments and script confusion can affect labels; short outputs remain explicitly unmeasured. No generated text or answer is exported.
